cards.title: Reporting of Model Parameters and Assumptions
cards.claim: PBPK reports must explicitly discuss assumptions and their biological/pharmacological rationale. System-dependent parameters (physiology) and drug-specific parameters (physicochemical, ADME) must be presented with sources and justification. Modifications to default system values must be highlighted. Drug-specific parameters should be reported with mean and variability (SD or range). If parameters are estimated, the estimation method and identifiability issues must be described.
conditions: Applies to all PBPK reports intended for regulatory assessment.
Literature references for system parameters must be provided as full articles.
Identifiability issues (e.g., correlated Ki and kinact) must be addressed with additional data or discussion.
required_inputs: Tabular summary of drug-specific parameters (mean, SD/range, source).
Documentation of any modifications to default system-dependent parameters.
Description of estimation methods for fitted parameters.
limitations: Does not define specific physiological values; relies on external literature.
Excerpts do not include the full list of 'Pharmacokinetic parameters used' beyond the definitions provided in chunk 0023.
cards.downstream_use: Ensures transparency in human simulation inputs. Allows reviewers to assess the biological plausibility of the model structure and parameter choices.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
